crossRefs.note: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you…
My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith…
Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.
Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your…
Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.
As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right. In the middle of…
Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.
Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of…
“But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose…
So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”
Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh…

people.name: Kir
people.line: A Moabite city, later destroyed by the Babylonians

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like pipes, and my heart sounds like pipes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.
translations.bsb: Therefore My heart laments like a flute for Moab; it laments like a flute for the men of Kir-heres, because the wealth they acquired has perished.
translations.kjv: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kirheres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.
translations.asv: Therefore my heart soundeth for Moab like pipes, and my heart soundeth like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: therefore the abundance that he hath gotten is perished.
